verdict.rationale: Restate exposes a documented HTTP invocation API, typed clients, an Introspection SQL API, and a CLI, all backed by first-party docs and confirmed via live runtime probes (CLI install, docs/MCP endpoint reachable). This gives AI-native users multiple concrete, documented ways to drive the product programmatically. missing for 10: no formal OpenAPI/swagger spec found (probe-2 404s), and no independent third-party corroboration of API usage beyond vendor docs and CLI probe.
